provenance: flash_chord sharpa_flash_sac scene (world_count=1, synthbox_box_open_000, control_fps=20, motion_speed=0.5) compiled solver.mj_model. Hand names mapped {side}_sharpa_wave_{side}_X -> {side}_X.

scene.basis: world_count=1. Bodies/joints map in order: newton body i == mj body i+1 (mj prepends 'world'), newton joint i == mj joint i (asserted at dump time, cross-checked against reference link names and jnt_qposadr/jnt_dofadr). Geoms: SolverMuJoCo skip_visual_only_geoms=True keeps only collision shapes; mj geom -> newton shape via the solver's mjc_geom_to_newton_shape row 0, cross-checked against the '{label}_{shape}' geom-name suffix. Ownership: hands via HandLayout.collision_shape_ids per side, objects via ObjectBinding.shapes, support via SupportBinding.shapes, ground via newton shapes with body -1. Hand body membership: left_/right_ name prefix (hand-only extractor rule).

notes: Object articulations (box_rotation) are driven like robot joints: one position + one velocity actuator merged to kp=50/kd=2, effort clamped joint-level via actfrcrange ±50; passive armature=0.01 / frictionloss=0.1 stay active under VOC scaling (ObjectJointPhysicsSpec).
Object free roots get dof damping 0 from object_free_joint_damping=0.0 (scene/train.yaml default through setup_scene); support root dofs are untouched and recorded verbatim.

Collision policy training.yaml adds robot<->support exclude pairs (robot_support_collision=false) on top of the hand-only exclude set; (box_bottom, box_top) is MuJoCo's parent-child exclusion. geom contype/conaffinity bitmasks are the full-scene collision-group coloring, copied verbatim per geom for later comparison.

SolverMuJoCo skip_visual_only_geoms=True: only collision shapes become mj geoms (56 = 52 hand + 2 object hulls + support + ground); visual meshes stay newton-side. Geom-name suffix _<shape> ties each mj geom back to its newton shape.

contact_ground: builder.add_ground_plane replaces only mu in default_shape_cfg (contact_friction=1.0), so the ground plane keeps the critically damped default solref [0.02, 1.0] while every robot/object/support geom carries dampratio 1.5811; solimp/friction/margin/gap match the uniform contact block.
